pages.Pans:
<templatestyles src="Template:Stat/styles.css" />

'''Pans''' are one of the key tools used by the player in ''Prospecting!''  They are vital for progression.

They can typically be found near [[Shopkeepers]], alongside their [[Shovels|shovel]] counterparts.

'''Pans''' have [[Stats|four core stats]]: {{Stat|Luck}}, {{Stat|Capacity}}, {{Stat|Shake Strength}}, and {{Stat|Shake Speed}}. Some pans also include unique passive stats or abilities.

You can [[Enchanting|enchant]] your pans and/or add [[Trinkets|Trinkets]] to them for extra perks.

You can change your equipped pan using the [[Prospector Kit]].

'''Minerals''' can be obtained by prospecting, and can later be sold at a [[Merchant]]. Minerals come in different rarities, and are found in different deposits. Every Mineral found by the player gets documented in the "Collection" item, which is part of the gear you get when first joining the game.

== Modifiers ==
See also: [[Modifiers]] - special effects that can change the value of minerals.

'''Shovels''' are one of the key tools used by the player in ''Prospecting!'' and are vital for progression.

They can typically be found near [[Shopkeepers]], alongside their [[Pans|pan]] counterparts.

'''Shovels''' have three main [[Stats|stats]]: {{Stat|Dig Strength}}, {{Stat|Dig Speed}}, and {{Stat|Toughness}}.

You can [[Enchanting#tabber-Shovels|enchant]] your shovel to give it extra abilities.

Use your [[Prospector Kit]] to change your equipped shovel.

'''Sluices''' are automated devices that sift valuables from running water in ''Prospecting!''. Great for passive income and progression. They can be placed in flowing water to collect while you explore or are offline. '''Sluices''' have [[Stats|four core stats]]: {{Stat|Luck}}, {{Stat|Capacity}}, {{Stat|Efficiency}}, and {{Stat|Toughness}}. Many sluices can be upgraded by talking to the [[Mad Scientist]] in the small workshop near the {{Crystal Caverns}} [[Waypoints|waypoint]]. pages.Enchanting:
== Enchanting == ''Notes'' * Enchants apply '''only''' to your currently equipped [[Pans|pan]] and [[Shovels|shovel]]. Max '''1''' enchant per pan/shovel (you can re-enchant anytime). == Available Enchantments == |-| Pans = == How to Enchant == [[File:Fortune Altar.png|thumb|The '''Fortune River Altar''']] * Head over to the Mysterious Altar located behind the Alchemist Store in {{Fortune River}}. * Make sure that the pan you want to enchant is the one you have equipped. * Interact with the altar and choose "Enchant my pan". * Click an ore ([[Aurorite]], [[Aetherite]], or [[Aetherium]]) on the left side. Enchanting will happen immediately! Make sure you don't accidentally click on an ore while scrolling through the list! * The name and stats of the resulting enchant will be shown on the right. If it's not the enchant you wanted, keep clicking ores; otherwise, close the interface. ''Notes'' * As an alternative to taking your chances with the altar, [[Relics#Enchant_Relics|Enchant books]] are available from the [[Traveling Merchant]] and [[Excavations|Excavation Sites]] for some enchant types. * The weight or modifier of the ore does '''not''' affect the rarity of the enchant you might get. {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |+ Available Pan Enchantments ! pages.Locations:
Here are a lot of the important locations you can find around the map! See the [[Waypoints]] page for the fast-travel locations. == '''Regular Areas''' ==
|-| Rubble Creek = ; {{Rubble Creek}} [[File:Starter_Area.png|300px|center]] * NPCs: [[John]], [[Trader]], [[Mechanic]] * This is where your journey begins! Speaking with [[John]] starts the tutorial and first quest. [[Trader]] also begins a series of three quests. * {{Rubble Creek}} - '''Toughness 1''' * {{Rubble Creek Deposits}} - '''Toughness 2''' |-| Fortune River = ; {{Fortune River}} [[File:Town.png|300px|center]] * NPCs: [[Shard Merchant]], [[Archaeologist]], [[Archaeologist?]], [[Kid]], [[Resident]], [[Steve]], [[Fisherman]], [[Dredge Master]] * Small town, big purpose! * {{Fortune River}} - '''Toughness 3''' |-| Fortune River Delta = ; {{Fortune River Delta}} [[File:Fortune_River_Delta.png|300px|center]] * NPCs: [[Shady Merchant]], [[Old Prospector]], [[Geologist]], [[Rock Climber]], [[Anne]] * Area known for its rich sediment, Fortune River flows into the ocean here. * {{Fortune River Delta}} - '''Toughness 4''' |-| Crystal Caverns = ; {{Crystal Caverns}} [[File:Crystal Caverns.png|300px|center]] * NPCs: [[Security Guard]], [[Clyde]], [[Head Researcher]], [[Miner]], [[Mad Scientist]] * A place rich with [[Minerals|Azuralite]] that only experienced prospectors may enter. * {{Crystal Cavern River}} - '''Toughness 4''' * {{Azuralite Oasis}} - '''Toughness 5''' ; {{Azuralite Oasis}} [[File:Azuralite Oasis.png|300px|center]] * NPC: [[Botanist]] * ??? * {{Azuralite Oasis}} - '''Toughness 5''' |-| Sunset Beach = ; {{Sunset Beach}} [[File:Beach.png|300px|center]] * NPCs: [[Pirate]], [[Beachgoer]], [[Surfer]], [[Lightkeeper]], [[Drake]], [[Pirate Captain]] * Once a tourist spot, now crowded by prospectors. Quests: ''[[Pirate|Heart of the Sea]]'' and ''[[Lightkeeper|Restoring the Lighthouse]]''. * {{Sunset Beach}} - '''Toughness 3''' |-| Museum = ; {{Museum}} [[File:Museum.png|300px|center]] * NPCs: [[Receptionist]], [[Bored Resident]] * The somewhat empty museum of Prospecting. |-| Caldera Park = ; {{Volcanic Sands}} [[File:volcanichuts.png|300px|center]] * NPCs: [[Ranger]], [[Tourist]], [[Surfer]], [[Disgruntled Local]], [[Arctic Traveler]] * The only place before the {{Magma Furnace}} where you can find a [[Fire Opal]]. * {{Volcanic Sands}} - '''Toughness 4''' ; {{Volcanic Springs}} [[File:volcanicsprings.png|300px|center]] * NPCs: [[Volcanic Researcher]] * {{Volcanic Springs}} - '''Toughness 5''' ; {{Windswept Beach}} [[File:windsweptbeach.png|300px|center]] * NPCs: [[Paleontologist]], [[Lightkeeper]] * The area where you can find the {{Ancient Ruins}}. * {{Windswept Beach}} - '''Toughness 4''' ; {{Magma Furnace}} [[File:magmafurnace.png|300px|center]] * NPCs: [[Flame Priest]], [[Master of the Forge]] * Extremely hot deposit area. You’ll need protection from [[Flame Priest]]. * {{Magma Furnace}} - '''Toughness 5''' ; {{Infernal Heart}} [[File:infernalheart.png|300px|center]] * It opens once per hour (XX:15) for 30 minutes before closing. * {{Infernal Heart}} - '''Toughness 5''' |-| Snowy Mountain = ; {{Snowy Shores}} [[File:Frostbite River.png|300px|center]] * NPCs: [[Arctic Traveler]], [[Researcher]], [[Apprentice Blacksmith]], [[Sherpa]], [[Builder]] * The base of the mountain — daring you to climb. * {{Snowy Shores}} - '''Toughness 5''' ; {{Frostbitten Path}} [[File:Frostbite Waterfall.png|300px|center]] * NPCs: [[Freezing Prospector]], [[Mountain Surveyor]] * A dangerous path winding up the icy cliffs. * {{Frostbitten Path}} - '''Toughness 6''' ; {{Frozen Peak}} [[File:Frozen Peak.png|300px|center]] * NPCs: [[Rock Climber]], [[Mountain Climber]], [[Fallen Artificer]] * The summit of the snowy mountain. * {{Frozen Peak}} - '''Toughness 6''' |-| Overgrown Caves = ; {{Overgrown Grotto}} [[File:Overgrown Grotto.png|300px|center]] * NPCs: [[Explorer_(Male)|Male Explorer]], [[Explorer_(Female)|Female Explorer]], [[Professor]], [[Disgruntled Explorer]], [[Old Druid]], [[Explorer]] * A lush cavern filled with life from the Tree of Light. * {{Overgrown Grotto}} - '''Toughness 6''' ; {{Deeproot Spring}} [[File:Deeproot Spring.png|300px|center]] * NPC: [[Druid]] * Underground roots curl around this precious fountain. * {{Deeproot Spring}} - '''Toughness 6''' ; {{Enchanted Ruins}} [[File:Enchanted_ruins_2.jpg|300px|center]] * NPCs: [[Ruins Archaeologist]], [[Ancient Sword]] * The power of the ruins pulls you in. * {{Enchanted Ruins}} - '''Toughness 6''' ; {{Abyssal Depth}} [[File:Abyssal Depths.png|300px|center]] [[File:Abyss Main.png|300px|center]] * NPC: [[Skeleton]] * The darkness wraps around you. * {{Abyssal Depth}} - '''Toughness 7''' |-| Swamp & Marsh = ; {{Rotwood Swamp}} [[File:rotwoodswamp.png|300px|center]] * NPCs: [[Swamp Man]], [[Ecologist]], [[Familiar Fisherman]], [[Fisherman's Friend]], [[Nuclear Scientist]], [[Swamp Kid]] * A thick fog covers hangs over the murky waters of the swamp. * {{Rotwood Swamp}} - '''Toughness 7''' ; {{Fungal Marsh}} [[File:fungalmarsh.png|300px|center]] * NPCs: [[Mushroom Man]], [[Froggy]], [[The Greatest Prospector]] * Toxic spores obscure your vision. * {{Fungal Marsh}} - '''Toughness 7''' ; {{Timelocked Sanctuary}} [[File:Timelocked_sanctuary.png|300px|center]] * It opens once per hour (XX:45) for 30 minutes before closing. * NPC: [[Timelocked Spirit]] * {{Timelocked Sanctuary}} - '''Toughness 8''' |-| Meteor Valley = [[File:Meteor Valley description.png|400px|center|The unending rain of meteors fills this valley with fortune.]] ; {{Meteor Falls}} [[File:METEORFALLS.png|300px|center]] * NPCs: [[Valley Girl]], [[Familiar Merchant]], [[Concussed Resident]], [[Clockmaker]] * {{Meteor Falls}} - '''Toughness 8''' ; {{Starfall River}} [[File:starfall.png|300px|center]] * NPCs: [[Meteor Wisp]], [[Astronomer]], [[Valley Golem]] * {{Starfall River}} - '''Toughness 9''' ; {{Astral Caverns}} [[File:astralcaverns.png|300px|center]] * NPC: [[Meteor Guardian]] * {{Astral Caverns}} - '''Toughness 10''' |-| Sunscorched Desert = [[File:Sunscorched Desert description.png|400px|center|The sun relentlessly beats down on those who traverse these sands.]] ; {{Sandstone Stream}} [[File:Sandstone Stream banner.png|300px|center]] * NPCs: [[Craftsman]], [[River Researcher]], [[Resting Traveler]] * {{Sandstone Stream}} - Toughness 10 ; {{Mystic Floodplains}} [[File:Mystic Floodplains.png|300px|center]] * [[Pharaoh's Sluice]] * {{Mystic Floodplains}} - Toughness 10 ; {{Lifespring Oasis}} [[File:Lifespring Oasis.png|300px|center]] * NPCs: [[Environmentalist]], [[Experienced Explorer]] * [[Pharaoh's Shovel]], [[Pharaoh's Pan]] * {{Lifespring Oasis}} - Toughness 11

|-| The Void = ; {{The Void}} [[File:TheVoid.png|300px|center]] * NPCs: [[Interdimensional Traveler]], [[Interdimensional Wanderer]] * An island at the edge of reality... * {{The Void}} - '''Toughness ???''' (no requirement) |-| Haunted Creek = ; {{Haunted Creek}} [[File:Hauntedcreek.Webp|300px|center]] * NPCs: [[Haunted Skeleton|Haunted Skeleton]], [[The Reaper]], [[Ghost]], [[Headless Merchant]] * A limited-time Halloween area. * {{Haunted Creek}} - '''Toughness ???''' (no requirement) |-| North Pole = ; {{North Pole}} [[File:Northpole.png|300px|center]] * NPCs: [[Gardener Elf]], [[Manager Elf]], [[Guard Elf]], [[Shopkeeper Elf]], [[Santa]] * A limited-time Christmas area. * {{North Pole}} - '''Toughness ???''' (no requirement) |-| Valentine's Event Shop= ; {{Fortune River}} [[File:Valentine's_Event_Shop.png|300px|center]] * NPCs: [[Merchant]] * A limited-time Valentine's area. * See [[Valentines Event Shop]] for more information. |-| Easter Event Shop= ; {{Fortune River}} [[File:easterevent.png|300px|center]] * NPCs: [[Merchant]] * A limited-time Easter area. * See [[Easter Event Shop]] for more information. |-| Seashell Isle= ; {{Seashell Isle}} [[File:Bonfire_-_in_progress.png|300px|center]] * A floating island that's only accessible in the summer. * NPCs: [[Island Guide]], [[Drake]], [[Photographer]], [[Vagrant]], [[Resident]], [[Beachgoer]], [[Surfer]] * {{Seashell Beach}} - Toughness 1

pages.Stats: {{Tocright}} == Overview == '''Stats''' in '''Prospecting!''' refer to the numerical values that dictate how you obtain and sell [[minerals]], among other things. === '''Stats''' can be affected by === * [[Equipment|Equipment]] * [[Events]] * [[Shovels]] and [[pans]] * [[Enchanting]] * Temporary boosts ** Daily rewards ** Completing certain [[:Category:Quests|Quests]] ** [[Codes]] == List of Stats == {| class="fandom-table" !Stat !Description !Factors |- |'''Dig Strength''' |Dig Strength refers to how much sediment you can add to your pan when digging. |[[Shovels|Shovel]], [[Enchanting]], [[Potions]] |- |'''Dig Speed''' |Dig Speed refers to how fast the bar moves on the perfect dig scale and the time in-between each dig. |[[Enchanting]], [[Potions]] |- |'''Shake Strength''' |Shake Strength refers to how much sediment you remove per click when panning. |[[Pans]], [[Enchanting]], [[Potions]] |- |'''Shake Speed''' |Shake Speed refers to how fast you can click while shaking. |[[Pans]], [[Enchanting]], [[Potions]] |- |'''Capacity (Pans)''' |Capacity (pans) refers to the amount of sediment you can store in your pan. Also affects how many [[minerals]] you can get from one pan cycle (square root of capacity = average minerals) and increases mineral size. |[[Pans]], [[Enchanting]], [[Potions]] |- |'''Capacity (Sluices)''' |Capacity (sluices) refers to the total number of [[minerals]] you can store in a [[Sluices|sluice]]. |[[Sluices]] |- |'''Efficiency (Sluices)''' |Efficiency refers to the amount of minerals a given sluice will accumulate each 10 minutes. |[[Sluices]] |- |'''Luck''' |Luck increases your chances of finding rarer/bigger [[minerals]]. Mechanics can be found [[Luck Mechanics|here]]. |[[Enchanting]], [[Events]], [[Potions]] |- |'''Size Boost''' |Size Boost refers to the multiplier that will affect [[Minerals|mineral]] weights when you pan for them. |[[Enchanting]], [[Events]] |- |'''Modifier Boost''' |Modifier Boost refers to the multiplier that will affect the chance for minerals to have [[Modifiers|modifiers]]. |[[Enchanting]], [[Events]], [[Potions]] |- |'''Sell Boost''' |Sell Boost refers to the multiplier to the amount of money you will receive when selling [[minerals]] and [[Equipment|equipment]] to a [[merchant]]. |[[Enchanting]], [[Events]], [[Potions]] |- |'''Inventory Size''' |Inventory size increases your max inventory space inside of your inventory. So, how many items you can carry. | |- |'''Self-Propulsion (Sluices)''' |Self-Propulsion allows you to put your sluice in non-moving water. (i.e. anywhere except {{The Void}} and the {{Infernal Heart}}) |[[Sluices]] |- |'''Autocollect (Sluices)''' |Autocollect will automatically collect ores from your sluice, '''as long as you are online'''. |[[Sluices]] |- |'''WalkSpeed''' |Determines how fast your character moves across the map. |[[Potions]], [[Runes]], [[Sluices|Easter Sluice]], [[Equipment]] |- |'''Jump Power''' |Determines the height of your character jump height. |[[Equipment]] |- |'''Status Timer Speed''' |Determines how much slower your buffs like potions and the cookie affect last, -50% means twice as long effects. |[[Equipment]] |- |'''Treasure Chest Chance''' |Increases the likelihood of discovering chests during activities. For more details, see the [[Treasure Map]] page. |[[Equipment]] |}

pages.Events: {{Tocright}} '''Events''' are limited-time happenings that give special effects to all players in the server. * They have a chance to occur every 30 minutes on the dot (XX:00 or XX:30), and are the same ''globally'' across all servers. * Players can use [[Relics]] to start certain events. (Those events are local to the server.) * Some are manually initiated by Developers during "Admin Abuse" times. == Regular Events == |-|Blizzard = The '''Blizzard''' is an every-30-minute event lasting 15 minutes on [[Snowy Mountain]] only. It can also be spawned using the [[Relics#tabber-Snow_Globe|Snow Globe]] relic. === Effects === * Multiplicative 1.5× '''[[Stats|Luck]]''' and '''1.5× items''' from panning at following locations: ** '''{{Frostbite River}}''' ** '''{{Frostbite Waterfall}}''' ** '''{{Frozen Peak}}''' === Dialogue === * Arrival: ''"Increased luck and amount on Snowy Island!"'' [[File:BlizzardProspecting.png|center|500px]] |-|Geode Shower= The '''Geode Shower''' is an every-30-minute event lasting 15 minutes. The Geode shower drops down meteors that contains a lot of geodes. It can also be spawned using the [[Relics#tabber-Cosmic_Resonator|Cosmic Resonator]] relic. === Effects === * Meteors containing [[Geodes]] drop over the course of 15 minutes. Each has at most 20 geodes each. * Meteors can only fall at the following locations: ** '''{{Fortune River}}''' ** '''{{Sunset Beach}}''' ** '''{{Fortune River Delta}}''' ** '''{{Windswept Beach}}''' ** '''{{Frostbite River}}''' === Dialogue === * Arrival: ''"Look up! Meteors are coming down bringing tons of geodes with them!"'' [[File:GeodeEvent.png|center|500px]] |-|Meteor Shower= The '''Meteor Shower''' is an every-30-minute event lasting '''20 minutes'''. It can also be purchased with Robux or spawned with a [[Meteor Fragment]], sending a server-wide message naming the buyer/spawner. Unlike other events, Meteor Showers can be "stacked", i.e. starting an additional one adds to the existing time. === Effects === * Multiplicative 2× [[Stats|Luck]] for everyone in the server. * 1-4 [[Meteor Shards]] can be obtained commonly from panning. === Dialogue === * Arrival: ''"A meteor shower has begun!"'' * Player-started: ''"A meteor shower has been started by [Player]!"'' * Departure: ''"The meteor shower has ended!"'' [[File:MeteorShower.png|center|500px]] |-|Mythic Rift = The '''Mythic Rift''' is an every-30-minute event and can spawn in every location. It can also be spawned using the [[Relics#tabber-Mythic_Summon|Mythic Summon]] relic. === Effects === * Guarantees that one player will find a '''mythic ore''' from that area. * Once obtained by one player, a server-wide message announces it, and the Rift disappears. === Dialogue === * Arrival: Dig in the zone for a chance to obtain the mythic gem! [[File:MythicRift.png|center|500px]] |-|Nimue's Blessing= '''Nimue's Blessing''' is an every-30-minute event lasting '''15 minutes''' in the Overgrown Caves ('''not''' including Abyssal Depths). [[File:Nimue's Blessing.png|center|500px]] |-|River Rapids= '''River Rapids''' is an every-30-minute event lasting '''15 minutes''' in {{Fortune River}} and {{Fortune River Delta}}. [[File:RiverRapids.png|center|500px]] |-|Solar Flare= The '''Solar Flare''' is an every-30-minute event lasting '''15 minutes'''. It can also be spawned with a [[Solar Token]] relic. A focused 10-minute Solar Flare can also be summoned with a [[Relics#tabber-Solar_Magnifier|Solar Magnifier]] relic. === Effects === * Small glowing patches spawn randomly on deposit areas. * Digging in these spots increases mineral '''weight''' by 2× and increases [[Modifiers|modifier]] chance. === Dialogue === * Arrival: Dig in the flare zones for improved size and modifier chance! [[File:SolarFlare.png|center|500px]] |-|Volcanic Eruption = The '''Volcanic Eruption''' is an every-30-minute event lasting '''15 minutes''' on {{Caldera Island}}. It can also be spawned using the [[Relics#tabber-Concentrated_Chaos|Concentrated Chaos]] relic. === Effects === * Provides a '''2× modifier chance''' for all items obtained. * Increases Modifier Luck by 2×, meaning rarer [[Modifiers|modifiers]] appear significantly more often. === Dialogue === * Arrival: ''"2x modifier chance and rare modifiers appear more often!"'' [[File:ModifierSurge.png|500px|center]] |-|Starfall = The '''Starfall''' event is a '''15 minute''' event in [[Meteor Valley]]. It can also be spawned using the [[Relics#tabber-Starcaller|Starcaller]] relic. === Effects === * Multiplicative 1.5× to both '''{{Stat|Luck}}''' and '''{{Stat|Modifier Boost}}''' from panning at the following locations. ** '''{{Meteor Falls}}''' ** '''{{Starfall River}}''' ** '''{{Astral Caverns}}''' [[File:Starfallevent.png|center|500px]] |-|Sandstorm = The '''Sandstorm''' event lasts '''15 minutes''' and affects the {{Sunscorched Desert}}. It can also be spawned using the [[Relics#tabber-Sand_Spirit|Sand Spirit]] relic. === Effects === * Multiplicative 1.5× to both '''{{Stat|Luck}}''' and '''{{Stat|Modifier Boost}}''' from panning at the following locations. ** '''{{Sandstone Stream}}''' ** '''{{Mystic Floodplains}}''' ** '''{{Lifespring Oasis}}''' [[File:Sandstorm banner.png|center|500px]] |-|The Void = [[The Void]] is an event lasting 30 minutes. pages.Merchant:
[[File:Merchantfort.png|right|300px]]

The '''Merchant''' is a recurring [[NPCs|NPC]] in ''Prospecting!''.  
They appear in multiple towns and digsites, allowing the player to sell [[Minerals]] and [[Equipment|equipment]] for money.  

Merchants are functionally the same as the [[Shady Merchant]], but are more common and serve as the main way to convert items into cash.

== Gameplay ==
Merchants allow the player to:
* Sell individual items
* Sell all items at once (except those favorited)
* Gain sell boosts through certain effects (see below)

== Locations ==

=== Mainland ===
* {{Rubble Creek}} — near [[John]] and the [[Trader]]  
* {{Fortune River}} — between the [[Kid]] and the [[Shard Merchant]]  
* {{Crystal Caverns}} — next to the [[Head Researcher]] and a [[Shopkeepers|Shopkeeper]]
* {{Sunset Beach}} — next to the shack

=== Caldera Park === 
* {{Volcanic Sands}} — close to the [[Ranger]] and the [[Waypoints|Waypoint]]  
* {{Magma Furnace}} — next to the Dragonflame [[equipment]] 

=== Snowy Mountain ===
* {{Snowy Shores}} — near the {{Frostbite River}} and the [[Researcher]]  
* {{Frostbitten Path}} — at the {{Frostbite Waterfall}}, under a tree  
* {{Frozen Peak}} — close to the [[Mountain Climber]]  

=== Overgrown Caves ===
* {{Overgrown Grotto}} — next to the [[Waypoints|waypoint]]
* {{Enchanted Ruins}} — sitting on a stone wall  

=== Rotwood Swamp ===
* {{Rotwood Swamp}} — in the house to the right of the [[Waypoints|waypoint]]
* {{Timelocked Sanctuary}} — on the left, near the shrine 

=== Meteor Valley ===
* {{Meteor Falls}} — near the [[Familiar Merchant]]
* {{Starfall River}} — across the river from the [[Astronomer]]   
* {{Astral Caverns}} — near the [[Alchemist|Alchemist's]] shop   

== Sell Boosts ==
Players can increase their sell rate temporarily or permanently:  
* '''Merchant’s Potion''' — bought from the [[Shard Merchant]] for {{Meteor Shards|200}} 
* [[Permanent_Buffs#Trader's_Recommendation|Trader's Recommendation (permanent buff)]]  
* Certain [[Codes]]  
* Putting {{Stat|Sell Boost}} ores in the [[Museum]]
* Some [[Equipment]]

pages.Shard Merchant: [[File:Shardmerchant.png|thumb|500x500px|''The '''Shard Merchant''' at her stand in {{Fortune River Town}}'']] The '''Shard Merchant''' is a vendor [[NPCs|NPC]] found in {{Fortune River Town}} and {{Caldera Park}}. She does not give any [[:Category:Quests|quests]] ''in Fortune River or Caldera Park'', but acts as a special merchant who trades items exclusively for {{Meteor Shards|Meteor Shards}}. (spoiler)She also shows up in a [[Familiar Merchant|third location]], where she doesn't sell anything, but gives a valuable quest. == Gameplay == The Shard Merchant allows the player to: * Purchase unique potions and totems using {{Meteor Shards|meteor shards}} instead of money * Use totems that apply temporary buffs in an area-of-effect * Gain rare, powerful boosts unavailable from normal [[Merchant|Merchants]] or [[Alchemist|Alchemists]] == Locations == * {{Fortune River Town}} — near the town center * {{Caldera Park}} (after a haircut) * (spoiler)[[Meteor Valley]] == Shop == {| class="wikitable" !Item !Cost !Description !Image |- |Luck Totem |{{Meteor Shards|300}} |An enchanted totem that grants 2x [[Stats|Luck]] to nearby players for 30 minutes. |[[File:Luck Totem.png|none|119x119px]] |- |Strength Totem |{{Meteor Shards|180}} |An enchanted totem that doubles dig and shake [[Stats|Strength]] of nearby players for 30 minutes. |[[File:Strength Totem.png|none|119x119px]] |- |Merchant's Potion |{{Meteor Shards|250}} |A potion that grants +100% [[Stats|Sell Value]] for 20 minutes. |[[File:Merchants Potion.png|none|119x119px]] |} == Notes == * Totems create a visible colored circle indicating their area-of-effect. * Buffs only apply while inside the radius of the placed totem. * It is recommended to place totems near [[Locations|deposit areas]] for maximum effect. pages.Equipment:
[[File:Prospector_Kit_Equipment_Equip.png|100px|thumb|The stat popup for a necklace in the Prospector Kit]] There are three types of equipment (jewelry) in the game: Necklaces, Charms, and Rings. You can wear one necklace and one charm, and up to 8 rings. Use the [[Prospector Kit]] to equip and unequip your jewelry, and/or to save or load a particular arrangement ("loadout"). Equipment can be crafted at the [[Crafting Anvil]] near the [[Blacksmith]] in multiple locations. Some equipment needs a [[Blueprint]] to be obtained before it can be crafted, while other equipment can be crafted by all players, provided they have the ingredients. Equipment can be [[Crafting_Anvil#Quality|improved]] in multiple ways. * When crafting, use larger/better ores to get more stars. * Ask the Blacksmith to '''reforge''' the equipment. This has a chance (though not a guarantee unless you use a [[Perfect Reforge Token]] or pay the Blacksmith with Robux) to raise the percentage score. * Merge two five-star equipment into one six-star equipment at the [[Magma Forge]]. * [[Mutations|Mutate]] the equipment at the forge at {{Frozen Peak}}. == List of Equipment ==  c = Catalyst for [[Mutations]] |-|Common= {| class="wikitable sortable equip-table" style="width:100%" ! __NOTOC__
= Potions =
'''Potions''' are consumable items in '''Prospecting''' that grant temporary stat boosts when used.  
They can be purchased from various merchants across the world.  

Each potion lasts for a limited time and provides effects such as increased '''Luck''', '''Capacity''', '''Strength''', '''Shake Speed''', and more.  

== Overview ==
Potions can be purchased from the following merchants:
* [[#Fortune River Town Alchemist|Fortune River Town Alchemist]] – basic Luck and Capacity potions  
* [[#Volcanic Sands Alchemist|Volcanic Sands Alchemist]] – powerful Luck and Strength potions  
* [[#Frostbitten Path Alchemist|Frostbitten Path Alchemist]] – more powerful Luck and Speed potions
* [[#Rotwood Swamp Alchemist|Rotwood Swamp Alchemist]] – even more powerful Luck potions
* [[#Astral Caverns Alchemist|Astral Caverns Alchemist]] - luck, strength, and size boost potions
* [[#Desert Alchemist|Desert Alchemist]] - luck, mod boost, and speed potions
* [[#Shard Merchant|Shard Merchant]] – potion focused on sell value  
* [[#Traveling Merchant|Traveling Merchant]] – rare and unique potions  

=== Usage ===
* Potions can be purchased "in bulk" by inputting the desired number.
** If you put in a larger number than the merchant's stock, it will say "out of stock" and no potions will be purchased.
* The potion(s) will go into your inventory (backpack) as a consumable item.
* To use a potion, select it in your inventory, then click/tap on the screen.
* When using the potion, if you have more than one, you can input the desired duration by selecting the number of potions to activate.
** Unlike the purchasing window, the duration window will not let you select more potions than what you have in your inventory.

pages.Luck Mechanics:
'''Luck''' is a [[Stats|Stat]] in '''Prospecting!'''
__NOTOC__
== Mechanics ==
The game's luck mechanics are as follows<ref>[https://discord.com/channels/1391817778087858216/1394648734935027762/1397710890014478498 From the Discord server]</ref>:

* The rarity of the item you get is based on a randomly rolled number, the lower it is the rarer. 
* Each point of luck is the amount of times this number will be rerolled, with the final number being the lowest of all the rolled numbers.
** Ex. Luck: 5 -> Rolls: (3, 2, 1, 4, 2) -> Final Roll: 1
* Luck has a set chance to either be weakened or not apply at all for each individual item, this is so common items don't become unobtainable at high luck (also why you might sometimes find like 5 commons with 1000 luck).
<references />

== Multipliers ==
As for how multiple luck ''multipliers'' are calculated, you just add together your bonus from the original— with the exception of the 2x luck from [[Events|Meteor Showers]].

=== Example 1 ===

* You have '''2x Luck''' from a [[Shard Merchant|totem]] and '''1.5x Luck''' from 5 friends being in your server;
** You have a '''2.5x Luck''' multiplier in total (''100 Luck --> 250 Luck'').
* If there is a [[Events|Meteor Shower]] happening in this same instance, it multiplies '''2x Luck''' on top of it;
** You end up with a '''5x Luck''' multiplier in total (''100 Luck --> 500 Luck'').

=== Example 2 ===

* You have '''2x Luck''' from a [[Codes|Code]], '''2x Luck''' from the daily reward, and '''1.2x Luck''' from having 2 friends in your server;
** You have a '''3.2x Luck''' multiplier in total (''100 Luck --> 320 Luck'').
* If there is a [[Events|Meteor Shower]] happening in this same instance, it multiplies '''2x Luck''' on top of it;
** You end up with a '''6.4x Luck''' multiplier in total (''100 Luck --> 640 Luck'').

== Sources ==

* [[Equipment|Equipment]] (adds a flat value, not a multiplier)
* Completing certain [[:Category:Quests|quests]] (adds a flat value, not a multiplier)
* [[Codes]]
* [[Events]]
* Daily rewards
* Friends being in your server (+0.1x multiplier, max of +0.5x)

== Trivia ==

* '''Luck''' takes effect when you set your pan down to dig; this means that you would want to ''pan'' where there is a [[Shard Merchant|Luck Totem]], and it does not actually matter what the '''Luck''' multiplier is when you dig.
* The boost you get from friends being in your server will only take effect when they join you or you join them as an existing friend.
** Thus, friending someone who is already in your server will not result in a boost (one of you can relog, however).
pages.Museum: {{Tocright}} [[File:Museum.png|thumb|300px|''The Museum'']] = Museum = The '''Museum''' is an indoor [[Locations|location]] in {{Caldera Park}} where players can place minerals into display pedestals to earn permanent stat boosts. Each display accepts minerals of a specific rarity, ranging from '''Common''' to '''Exotic'''. The '''Museum''' also has a [[Vault]] to the right of the [[Receptionist]], as well as a [[Manage Museums Board]] and [[Visit Museums Globe]]. == Staff == * [[Receptionist]] — Quest-giving NPC who manages the Museum. == Extras == * [[Vault]] — Allows players to store extra minerals and materials * [[MVP|Voting box]] — Vote for the next [[MVP]] * [[Manage Museums Board]] — Save different museum setups and quickly switch between them * [[Visit Museums Globe]] — See what other players have in their museums == Displays == [[File:Museum_Display.png|thumb|280px|''A Display Pedestal'']] The Museum contains rarity-based displays. * For '''Common''' through '''Legendary''' rarities, each rarity has '''1 free display''' and '''2 locked displays''', one unlockable with money, the other with [[Meteor Shards]]. * For the '''Mythic''' rarity, there are only 2 displays (money + shards, no free). * The '''Exotic''' rarity has only 1 display (shards only). {| class="wikitable" style="width:100%; text-align:center;" ! [[File:Prospector Kit hotbar.png]] [[File:Prospector Kit popup.png|150px|thumb|The Prospector Kit is "used to manage your equipment."]] The Prospector Kit is arguably the most important interface in the game. It's where you can equip and unequip your tools ([[Pans|pans]], [[Shovels|shovels]], and [[Sluices|sluices]]) and [[Equipment|equipment]] (rings, charms, and necklaces). The Pans tab is also where you can equip [[Trinkets]], and the Equipment tab is where you can equip [[Runes]]. == Pans == [[File:Prospector Kit Pans.png|400px|thumb|The equipped pan is Pharaoh's Pan with Irregular enchantment and Beach Umbrella trinket]] The pans you own are listed on the left side. If a pan has an [[Enchanting|enchantment]] applied, it is shown before the name of the pan. The currently-selected pan is shown on the right side, along with its description and [[Stats]]. [[File:Prospector Kit Pan Enchant Stats.png|200px|none]] The effects of the enchantment (if any) are shown after the pan's base stats, in a color that matches the enchantment's name. If the selected pan is currently equipped, the button at the bottom will say "[Equipped]"; otherwise, the button will say "Equip", and clicking it will change your pan to the new selection. You cannot unequip all pans; you can only switch between them. The button below the right side shows the [[Trinkets|trinket]] applied to the selected pan, if any. Click the button to change the trinket. == Shovels == [[File:Prospector Kit Shovels.png|400px|thumb|The selected (but not equipped) shovel is a Mastered-enchanted Starcrusher.]] The shovels you own are listed on the left side. If a shovel has an [[Enchanting|enchantment]] applied, it is shown before the name of the shovel. The currently-selected shovel is shown on the right side, along with its description and [[Stats]]. The effects of the enchantment (if any) are shown below the shovel's description, in a color that matches the enchantment's name. If the selected shovel is currently equipped, the button at the bottom will say "[Equipped]"; otherwise, the button will say "Equip", and clicking it will change your shovel to the new selection. As with pans, it is not possible to unequip all shovels; you can only switch between them. == Sluices == [[File:Prospector Kit Sluices.png|400px|thumb|The Pharaoh's Sluice with 35 upgrade points applied]] The sluices you own are listed on the left side. If a sluice has been [[Sluices#tabber-Sluice_Upgrades_(Crystal_Caverns)|upgraded]], the number of upgrade points is listed in parentheses after the sluice name. The currently-selected sluice is shown on the right side, along with its description and [[Stats]]. If a stat has been upgraded, the amount added will be listed in parentheses after the base number. Note that only the four numeric stats are listed — Autocollect and Self-Propulsion are not shown in the Prospector Kit. === Equipping and Unequipping === * If the selected sluice is currently equipped, the button at the bottom will say "Unequip". Clicking the button will remove the sluice from your hotbar (as well as the body of water it was in, if any). * If the selected sluice is not the one currently equipped, the button at the bottom will say "Equip". Clicking the button will change your hotbar button to the new sluice, or if you didn't have a sluice equipped previously, it will add a button. ** If there's no room on your hotbar, the sluice will be put in your backpack, but next time you rejoin, it will almost certainly scramble your hotbar to make room for the sluice. == Equipment == [[File:Prospector Kit Equipment.png|400px|thumb|A luck-efficiency equipment loadout]] The left side of the screen has two parts: on the top is a list of your available equipment (in pretty much random order), and on the bottom is a list of your saved loadouts (again, in random order, though at least it doesn't move them around once saved). The right side of the screen shows the equipment slots available and what you're wearing in them. It also has a button for selecting your [[Runes]]. If you have yet to purchase a ring slot, its price (in {{Meteor Shards|Meteor Shards}}) will be shown; click the slot to buy it. The last two ring slots can be purchased in the [[Prospector's_Shop#Passes|Prospector's Shop]] (for Robux). === Equipping and Unequipping ===
[[File:Prospector Kit Equipment Unequip.png|100px|left]] To unequip something you're currently wearing, click or tap on it on the right side of the screen.
[[File:Prospector Kit Equipment Equip.png|100px|left]] * To equip something, first make sure there's an empty slot for it, then click or tap it on the left side of the screen. ** Alternatively, close the Prospector Kit, find the item in your backpack, select it, then "use" it by clicking on the screen.
=== Loadouts === The game will let you save up to 10 named sets of equipment, called a "loadout". Unlike [[Museum]] ores, you can use your equipment in as many loadouts as you wish. ;Saving a new loadout # Equip the desired arrangement of necklaces, charms, and rings on the right side of your screen. # Click the "Save As"[ahem, sorry] "New+" button. # Type in a name for the loadout, then click the Confirm button. ;Using a loadout # Click the name of the loadout in the list on the left. # There is no step 2. ;Deleting a loadout # Click the trashcan icon next to the name of the loadout. # Click Yes to confirm. ;Editing a loadout # Click the name of the loadout you want to change. # Make the desired changes (see [[#Equipping_and_Unequipping_2|Equipping and Unequipping]] above). # Delete the existing loadout name. # Save the new loadout.

pages.Crystal Caverns:
{{Tocright}}

[[File:Crystal Caverns.png|thumb|280px|''Entrance to the Crystal Caverns'']]

= Crystal Caverns =
'''Crystal Caverns''' is a [[Locations|location]] on the [[Mainland]].  
It has one digging site, {{Crystal Cavern River}}, and one sub-area, {{Azuralite Oasis}}.  

== Main Town ==

=== Shop ===
The shop sells one [[Pans|pan]] and one [[Shovels|shovel]].

[[File:Crystal Caverns Shop.png|thumb|280px|''The Shop'']]
'''Pan'''
* Aurora Pan — $35,000,000

'''Shovel'''
* Divine Shovel — $40,000,000

=== Sluice Upgrade Room ===
[[File:SluiceUpgradeDoor.png|thumb|280px|''Door leading to the Sluice Upgrade area'']]  
[[File:SluiceUpgradeRoom.png|thumb|280px|''Inside the Upgrade Room'']]  

The '''Sluice Upgrade Room''' can be accessed through the special door in the {{Crystal Caverns}}.  
Here, players can enhance their [[Sluices|sluices]] by investing resources to improve their stats and efficiency.  

Upgrading your sluice increases its effectiveness, making it possible to yield more valuable [[minerals]] during offline farming.

=== Other NPCs & Utilities ===
* [[Waypoints|Waypoint]] — teleportation between locations  
* [[Merchant]] — allows selling of [[minerals]] and [[Equipment|equipment]]  
* [[Head Researcher]] — quest-giving NPC  
* '''Security Guard''' — prevents players below level 15 from entering  
* '''Scientist''' — researches [[Azuralite]]  
* '''Miner''' — believes mining operations will soon resume  

== Waterfall Temple ==
[[File:Crystal_Caverns_Temple.png|thumb|280px|''Entrance to the Waterfall Temple'']]  
The '''Waterfall Temple''' is hidden behind the waterfall at {{Crystal Cavern River}}.  
To enter, you must sacrifice an [[Emerald]], a [[Diamond]], and a [[Starshine]].  

Inside, there is a shop and one NPC.  

; Shop Items
* Earthbreaker Shovel — $125,000,000  
* Worldshaker Pan — $125,000,000  

; NPC
* [[???]] — grants a [[Permanent Buffs|permanent buff]] of '''+5''' {{stat|Luck}} after dialogue  

== Crystal Cavern River ==
[[File:Crystal_Cavern_Digsite.png|thumb|280px|''The Digsite'']]  
The '''Crystal Cavern River''' is the first digsite in the {{Crystal Caverns}}.  
It requires '''Toughness 4''' (at least a '''Meteoric Shovel''').  
There are '''19''' possible [[minerals]].  

; Minerals
* {{Common}} — [[Silver]], [[Copper]], [[Gold]], [[Amethyst]]  
* {{Uncommon}} — [[Neodymium]], [[Smoky Quartz]], [[Malachite]]  
* {{Rare}} — [[Onyx]], [[Azuralite]]  
* {{Epic}} — [[Ashvein]], [[Emerald]], [[Borealite]], [[Osmium]]  
* {{Legendary}} — [[Palladium]], [[Luminum]], [[Starshine]], [[Aetherite]]  
* {{Mythic}} — [[Inferlume]], [[Vortessence]]  

== Sublocation ==
* The {{Azuralite Oasis}} is a sub-area of the {{Crystal Caverns}}. It requires '''Toughness 5''', and contains the [[Enchanting#tabber-Shovels|shovel enchanting altar]].

pages.Ancient Ruins:
= Ancient Ruins =

[[File:Ancient Ruins (Entrance).png|600px|center]]

The '''Ancient Ruins''' are a discoverable landmark located within the {{Windswept Beach}} area.  
They’re referenced on the Windswept Beach entry as “the area where you can find the {{Ancient Ruins}}.”

== Overview ==
A set of weathered structures half-claimed by sand and wind. The site is frequently visited by prospectors exploring {{Windswept Beach}}.

== How to Reach ==
* Found within {{Windswept Beach}}.  
* From the waypoint head towards the lighthouse and complete the quest for the [[Lightkeeper]]. Then go down the lighthouse.
* Nearest fast-travel: see [[Waypoints]].

== NPCs & Services ==
* Nearby NPCs at {{Windswept Beach}}: [[Paleontologist]], [[Merchant]], [[Lightkeeper]].

== Mechanics & Puzzles ==
* To access the ancient ruins you need to open the hatch with a [[Volcanic Key]]. Inside you then need to open the door with 1 [[Catseye]], 1 [[Uranium]] and 1 [[Flarebloom]].

=== Maze Solution ===
* '''Shovel & Pan''' — Left, then right, then left. Interact with the bookshelf in the final room to find the '''Fossilized Shovel''' and '''Fossilized Pan'''.
* '''Sluice''' — Turn right three times. Found among barrels is the '''Fossilized Sluice'''.

Ancient Ruins (Entrance).png|Overview of the Ancient Ruins.
</gallery>

= Deeproot Spring =
'''Deeproot Spring''' is a sub-location within {{Overgrown Grotto}}.  

== Services & NPCs ==
* [[Waypoints|Waypoint]] - fast travel between locations
* [[Pans|Pan]]: Lifetouched Pan — $100,000,000,000
* [[Shovels|Shovel]]: Lifetouched Shovel — $80,000,000,000
* [[Sluices|Sluice]]: Lifetouched Sluice — $50,000,000,000
* [[Excavations#tabber-Deeproot_Spring|Excavation Site D: Lost City]]
* [[Druid]] - quest-giving [[NPCs|NPC]]
* [[Explorer]]

== Digsite ==
The spring requires '''Toughness 6'''. There are 21 possible [[Minerals|minerals]].

; Minerals
* {{Common}} — [[Silver]], [[Copper]], [[Gold]]
* {{Uncommon}} — [[Neodymium]], [[Glowberry]], [[Smoky Quartz]], [[Malachite]]
* {{Rare}} — [[Amber]], [[Azuralite]]
* {{Epic}} — [[Glowmoss]], [[Emerald]], [[Cobalt]], [[Lightshard]], [[Aurorite]]
* {{Legendary}} — [[Luminum]], [[Starshine]], [[Specterite]], [[Aetherite]]
* {{Mythic}} — [[Chrysoberyl]], [[Radiant Gold]]
* {{Exotic}} — [[Vineheart]]
[[File:Zrzut ekranu (315).png|thumb|250px|''A Firefly Zone.'']]

== Firefly Zones ==
* '''Firefly Zones''' can spawn here. Digging inside an active zone greatly increases the chances of finding [[Firefly Stone|Firefly Stones]].

== Access ==
Talk to the [[Old Druid]] in the {{Overgrown Grotto}} to get the [[Relics#tabber-Enchanted_Scissors|enchanted scissors]], then use the scissors to cut the vines blocking the path to the Spring. The scissors are also needed to go up the path that gives access to the [[Sluices|sluice]], the [[Pans|pan]] & {{Abyssal Depth}} (to the right), and the [[Shovels|shovel]] & [[Druid]] (to the left).

= The Abyssal Depths =
'''Abyssal Depths''' is an underground sub-[[Locations|location]] wherein the darkness seems to surround you from every direction. 

Upon entering the Abyss, a purple bar will appear on your screen. To prevent it from filling up, remain close to a [[Firefly Flare]] or Luminant totem. If the bar reaches its maximum, it will result in death.

== Main Area ==

=== Services and NPCs ===
* There is a [[Merchant]] just outside the entrance
* [[Skeleton]] — blueprint-giving NPC  
* [[Firefly Flare|Firefly flare crafting table]] — located just outside the entrance. Firefly flares are consumable items that allow you to stay inside the Abyss without dying.

=== How to Access ===
[[File:Abyss Entrance.png|thumb|250px|''Abyssal Depths Entrance'']]  
[[File:Path Abyssal.png|250px|thumb|''The path that leads to Abyss'']]
* The entrance to Abyssal Depths can be found by going up and around {{Deeproot Spring}} towards the area where you can buy the [[Lifetouched Pan]].
** To enter the depths, jump in the hole.
* There is a ladder that you can set up to easily access the Abyss from the {{Overgrown Grotto}}, without going the long way around Deeproot Spring.
[[File:LadderAbyss.png|250px|center]]

=== How to Exit ===
There is a rope hanging down near the middle of the main area. Climb it to exit the Abyss.

== Digsites ==
[[File:Abyss Main.png|thumb|280px|''The Abyssal Depths digsite'']]  
The digsite of {{Abyssal Depth}} requires '''Toughness 7''' (at least a '''Lifetouched Shovel''').  
There are '''19''' possible [[minerals]].

; Minerals
* {{Common}} — [[Copper]], [[Gold]], [[Silver]]
* {{Uncommon}} — [[Malachite]], [[Neodymium]], [[Smoky Quartz]]
* {{Rare}} — [[Amber]], [[Azuralite]], [[Gloomberry]]
* {{Epic}} — [[Aurorite]], [[Cobalt]], [[Emerald]], [[Lightshard]]
* {{Legendary}} — [[Aetherite]], [[Specterite]], [[Starshine]]
* {{Mythic}} — [[Painite]], [[Radiant Gold]]
* {{Exotic}} — [[Umbrite]]

== The Maze ==
[[File:AbyssGate.png|250px|thumb|''The Gate within the Abyssal Depths'']]
To open the gate to the maze, players must collect a total of '''25,000 minerals''' within the Abyss.  

The following items are obtainable within the maze:  

; Pan
* Abyssal Pan — $200,000,000,000  

; Shovel
* Abyssal Shovel — $200,000,000,000  

; Equipment Blueprint
* Umbrite Ring

; Rune
* [[Runes|Abyssal Rune]]

=== Maze Solution ===
[[File:Abyss Map.png|thumb|280px|'''The Maze Solution (Credits to @zulisian on discord)''']]

; Umbrite Ring Blueprint
* Enter the Maze until you reach an intersection. Go down the path on the right until you spot another intersection, to which you continue down the path along the grass pathways. There will be a left turn down the path to which you can just ignore as you continue straight until you spot a Skeleton NPC, where you interact to receive the Umbrite Ring Blueprint.

; Abyssal Pan
* Enter the Maze until you reach an intersection. Go down the path on the right until you spot another intersection, to which you continue down the path along the grass pathways. There will be a left turn down the path where you're faced with an obby. Once you're past it, continue down the path to the right, and then take another right, followed by a left, ending up with a right turn until you reach the Abyssal Pan.

; Abyssal Shovel
* Enter the Maze until you reach an intersection. Go down the path on the left until you spot another intersection, to which you can ignore and just go straight until you find a path leading upwards. Climb all the way to the top while continuing on the path until you see a faint glow in the distance, and that's where you'll find the Abyssal Shovel.

=== Tips for the Maze ===
* Carry 10–15 Firefly Flares to keep the path lit.
* Go with another player — the buddy system helps prevent disorientation.
* Drop Firefly Flares at each intersection to mark where you’ve been and keep the darkness from consuming you.
* Find a large Luminum (12–18kg) to provide extra light — it won’t stop the darkness, but it helps visibility.
* Take your time and enjoy exploring the cave!

pages.Blacksmith:
[[File:Blacksmith.png|right|300px]]

The '''Blacksmith''' is a recurring [[NPCs|NPC]] in ''Prospecting!''.  
They allow the player to '''Reforge''' their [[Equipment|equipment]] to gain better stat boosts.  

Blacksmiths are found in multiple regions, usually close to [[Crafting Anvil|Crafting]] stations.  

== Gameplay ==
Blacksmiths provide the option to:
* Reforge equipment to reroll stats
* Increase prices with each reforge
* Perform a ''<u>Perfect Reforge</u>'' using Robux or a special token

== Locations ==

=== Mainland ===
* {{Rubble Creek}} — near the [[Trader]] and the local [[Equipment|Crafting]] station  
* {{Fortune River}} — close to the Leaderboards and the [[Equipment|Crafting]] station  

=== Snowy Mountain ===
* {{Frostbite River}} — near the [[Apprentice Blacksmith]] and the [[Equipment|Crafting]] station

=== The Swamp ===
* {{Rotwood Swamp}} — next to the [[Merchant]] and the [[Ecologist]]

== Reforging ==
Reforging allows players to reroll an equipment’s stats for a fee.  
Each attempt increases in price the more the item is reforged.  

=== Perfect Reforge ===
Players can use:
* '''Robux''' — R$199 (for below {{Legendary}}) or R$299 (for {{Legendary}} and above)  
* {{Perfect Reforge Token}} 

A ''<u>Perfect Reforge</u>'' instantly boosts one piece of [[Equipment|equipment]] to '''100% quality''', making all stats max value.  

⚠️ It is not recommended to use a Perfect Reforge on equipment below '''5★ quality''', as this lowers the maximum stat values and reduces benefits.

== Ancient Ruins ==
[[File:Ancient Ruins (Entrance).png|thumb|280px|''The entrance to the Ancient Ruins'']]  
The Ancient Ruins are hidden beneath the lighthouse at {{Windswept Beach}}.  
You must unlock the trapdoor with a [[Volcanic Key]] (obtained at the {{Infernal Heart}}) and sacrifice a [[Catseye]], [[Flarebloom]], and [[Uranium]] to enter.  

Inside is a maze containing powerful tools.

=== Maze Solution ===
* '''Shovel & Pan''' — Left, then right, then left. Interact with the bookshelf in the final room to find the '''Fossilized Shovel''' and '''Fossilized Pan'''.
* '''Sluice''' — Turn right three times. Found among barrels is the '''Fossilized Sluice'''.

* Fossilized Pan — $1,000,000,000  
* Fossilized Sluice — $800,000,000

[[File:Arctic Traveler.png|thumb|''The '''Arctic Traveler''' in front of his boat'']]
{{Tocright}}

The '''Arctic Traveler''' is an [[NPCs|NPC]] who appears in two locations:  
* In {{Caldera Park}}, where he offers a quest before taking the player to the {{Snowy Shores}}.  
* On the {{Snowy Shores}}, where he can return the player back to {{Caldera Park}}.  

He acts as a grumpy ferryman between the two islands, seemingly caught in a constant state of misery—either freezing in the tundra or sweating on the volcanic shores while complaining about whichever one he is currently stuck on.

== Locations ==

=== Caldera Park ===
==== Quests ====
{{Quest
|Quest = Icebreaker
|QuestSub = Melt the ice and unlock passage to the Snowy Shores.
|QuestStep1 = Talk to the Arctic Traveler while holding the [[Shovels#tabber-Magma_Furnace|Dragonflame Shovel]]
|Rewards = {{$|1,000,000}} • {{EXP|100,000}} • {{Meteor Shards|250}} • Access to {{Snowy Shores}}
}}

==== Dialogue ====
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Arctic Traveler:''' AGHH! Why is the way back FROZEN? Now I’m stuck on this miserably hot island!  

:{{Choice|Are you from the Snowy Mountain?}}  
::'''Arctic Traveler:''' Yeah, I am. I CAN’T GO BACK, THOUGH. IT’S BLOCKED WITH ICE!  
::'''Arctic Traveler:''' If only I had something hot enough to melt through it…  

:{{Choice|I can help you if you promise to take me there.}}  
::'''Arctic Traveler:''' Uh, sure. Maybe you can find something on this stupid flaming island.  
::;(Quest started: '''Icebreaker''')
----
;{{Action|While quest is active, not completed}}  
:'''Arctic Traveler:''' Found a solution yet? Judging from the look on your face, I guess not.  
----
;{{Action|Quest completion — player has Dragonflame Shovel}}  
:'''Arctic Traveler:''' Wait… that shovel you have… That can melt through the ice!  
:'''Arctic Traveler:''' I can finally get off this blasted island!  
:'''Arctic Traveler:''' Thanks for the help. I can take you to the {{Snowy Shores|Snowy Mountains}} anytime.  
::;(Rewards given: {{$|1,000,000}} • {{EXP|100,000}} • {{Meteor Shards|250}} • Access unlocked)  
----
;{{Action|After completion — access unlocked}}  
:'''Arctic Traveler:''' Need a ride to the {{Snowy Shores|Snowy Mountains}}?  
:{{Choice|Yes.}}  
::'''Arctic Traveler:''' Alright, hop on then.  
:{{Choice|No.}}  
::'''Arctic Traveler:''' It’s way too hot here.  
{{Dialogue End}}

=== Snowy Shores ===
==== Dialogue ====
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Arctic Traveler:''' Need to go back to {{Caldera Park}}? Dunno why you’d want to, though.  
:{{Choice|Yes.}}  
::'''Arctic Traveler:''' Hahh… alright, hop on then.  
:{{Choice|No.}}  
::'''Arctic Traveler:''' Ah, finally back home!  
{{Dialogue End}}

== Notes ==
* The '''Arctic Traveler''' functions as a '''travel NPC''' after completing his quest.  
* He is required to unlock access to {{Snowy Shores}}, making him a progression checkpoint NPC.

* When spawned, a portal appears at {{Fortune River}}.

== The Void Digsite ==
The Void digsite's loot pool is unique — it ''changes every time the Void spawns''.  

There is no [[Shovels|shovel]] toughness requirement, and any ore from the game, ''including limited-time ores'' (and except Exotics that aren’t [[Voidstone]]) can appear here. This makes it one of the most unpredictable and lucrative areas.  

The odds for all ores in the same rarity tier are the same, giving the player an opportunity to more easily obtain ores that would otherwise be rarer outside of The Void. The odds for each ore in The Void are shown below.

[[Meteor Shards]] can be obtained commonly from panning, similar to [[Events|Meteor Shower]].

; Minerals  
* {{Common}} — random set of five (changes each spawn) • 18.1132% (~1 in 6) 
* {{Uncommon}} — random set of five (changes each spawn) • 1.8113% (~1 in 55) 
* {{Rare}} — random set of four (changes each spawn) • 0.09057% (~1 in 1,104) 
* {{Epic}} — random set of four (changes each spawn) • 0.003623% (~1 in 27,604) 
* {{Legendary}} — random set of four (changes each spawn) • 0.0001811% (~1 in 552,084) 
* {{Mythic}} — random set of three (changes each spawn) • 0.000002536% (~1 in 39,434,575) 
* {{Exotic}} — [[Voidstone]] • 0.0000007245% (~1 in 138,021,012)  

=== The Gate === 
[[File:Void Gate.png|thumb|250px|''The Gate within the Void'']]  
At the heart of the Void used to lie a gate.  
To open it, players had to collect a total of '''15,000 items''' within the Void.  

Behind the gate, a hidden shop became available:  

; Pan (Unobtainable)
* Galactic Pan — $2,000,000,000  

; Shovel (Unobtainable) 
* Galactic Shovel — $2,000,000,000

[[File:rotwoodcroc.png|thumb|200px|''A crocodile about to attack.'']]
Crocodiles are a threat that can kill you if you get their attention. They are scared of Luminant Totems. (As long as you are in the totem radius, they won't attack you.) They also go dormant during the [[Events#tabber-Swamp_Fog|Swamp Fog]] event.

=== Panning Safely ===
In addition to using Luminant Totems or panning during the Swamp Fog event, there are locations that allow panning without being in danger from crocodiles.

* The boat: use the front or back of the boat, including its windshield, but not including the waterlogged middle part.
* The dock where the [[Swamp Kid]] is standing.
* Lily pads that are close enough to shore.
* Any of the plank bridges (but not the tree-trunk bridges). Be careful not to fall off, especially if auto-panning.

pages.Treasure Map:
{{Tocright}}

== Treasure Map ==
A '''Treasure Map''' is a special item you can uncover while digging on various locations around the map. Equipping it guides you to the exact spot where a hidden [[Treasure Chest]] is buried. 

== Overview ==
A Treasure Map is easier to discover when your digspeed is lower. Its base 0.2% drop chance scales inversely to your digspeed. Players can have a maximum of '''5''' Treasure Maps in their inventory at a time. This limit increases to '''10''' with the {{Enchant|Treasure Hunter}} [[Enchanting#tabber-Shovels|shovel enchant]].

[[File:Treasuremap.png|thumb|right|280px|''Equipped Treasure Map'']]

== Obtainment ==
* Dig in any location.
** If you dig in a location that has treasure chests, you have an increased chance of finding that type of map.
* Once a map is found, yellow text will appear on your screen that says "You have found a mysterious map!" 
* Check your inventory (backpack) to see what type of map you found.

== Usage ==
* Head to the location specified on the map.
* Once at the location, click on the map in your inventory to equip it.
* A colored arrow will appear on the screen. Follow the arrow. 
* When you arrive at the correct location, the colored arrow will point at the ground and the text "X Marks the Spot! Dig down!" will appear. 
* When you dig in the location marked by the X, text will appear on the screen that says "You have found buried treasure!!" 
* A [[Treasure Chest]] will appear in your inventory.

=== Troubleshooting ===
* If the arrow points down at a location that is not a deposit, meaning you can't dig there, try digging anywhere in the general vicinity: the hitbox for treasure chests is pretty generous.
* If the arrow keeps going around in circles instead of turning vertical, it might be trying to point at a location that's above you or below you. Try climbing up or down, then checking the map again.
* If, despite your best efforts, you cannot dig up the treasure chest the map is pointing to, '''sell the map''' to a [[Merchant]].
[[File:Tip treasure.png|thumb|center|500px|alt=Tip: Treasure maps can be sold at a merchant if you cannot find their treasure!|Server chat message about recalcitrant treasure maps]]

== Map Types ==
Treasure maps can be obtained anywhere, but they can only point to the following locations:
* {{Fortune River}}
* {{Fortune River Delta}}
* {{Sunset Beach}}
* {{Volcanic Sands}}
* {{Windswept Beach}}
* {{Frostbite River}}
* {{Rotwood Swamp}}
* {{Starfall River}}

== Overview ==
The '''Advent Calendar Elf''' was an [[NPCs|NPC]] located in {{North Pole}} next to the Equipment Crafting station and the entrance to the North Pole. 

Now a piece of the game's history, this cheery assistant once served as the primary gatekeeper for holiday rewards, politely directing prospectors toward their daily gifts. While the elf is currently gone, there is always a chance they will return with a fresh batch of gifts when Christmas rolls around again.

= Meteor Valley =
'''Meteor Valley''' is a [[Locations|location]] found behind the {{Timelocked Sanctuary}}, near [[The Greatest Prospector]]. 
To gain access, you must first complete the [[Quests#tabber-Timelocked_Sanctuary|Lost in Time]] quest and then pull the lever to open the door.

{{Tocright}} = Seashell Isle = [[File:Seashell Isle Banner.png|500px|center]] '''Seashell Isle''' is the [[Locations|location]] of the Summer Event. It is a moving island that floats around on its own, and is only close enough to the mainland to sail to in the summer. == Getting There == To get to Seashell Isle, talk to the [[Ferryman]] at the {{Fortune River}} dock during the Summer Event. == Shops == === Blueprint and Trinket Vendor === [[File:Summer Relic Vendor.png|border|250px|The blueprint and trinket vendor's stall]]
This [[Blueprint_%26_Trinket_Vendor|vendor]] sells two blueprints and one trinket. * [[Blueprint#tabber-Waverider_Blueprint|Waverider Blueprint]] – {{Sand Dollars|1000}} (stock: 1) * [[Blueprint#tabber-Shell_Necklace_Blueprint|Shell Necklace Blueprint]] – {{Sand Dollars|500}} (stock: 1) * [[Trinkets|Beach Umbrella (Trinket)]] – {{Sand Dollars|1000}} === Relic Vendor === [[File:Summer Blueprint Vendor.png|border|250px|The relic vendor's stall]]
This [[Relic_Vendor|vendor]] sells a limited stock of five [[Relics|relics]]. * {{Meteor Fragment}} – {{Sand Dollars|300}} (stock: 1) * {{Void Shard}} – {{Sand Dollars|300}} (stock: 1) * {{Infernal Idol}} – {{Sand Dollars|50}} (stock: 5) * {{Solar Magnifier}} – {{Sand Dollars|40}} (stock: 25) * {{Friendship Totem}} – {{Sand Dollars|40}} (stock: 50 per day) === Bonfire Shop === [[File:Summer_XPCookie.png|border|200px|XP cookie near the Bonfire]]
Up to 200 {{XP Cookie}}s can be purchased per day for {{Sand Dollars|20}} each from a spot next to the Bonfire. == Quest-giving NPCs == * [[Photographer]] * [[Drake]] * [[Vagrant]] == Other NPCs & Utilities == * [[Merchant]] — allows selling of [[minerals]] and [[Equipment|equipment]] * [[Waypoints|Waypoint]] — fast travel to other locations * [[Island Guide]] — information-giving NPC * [[Ferryman]] — travel back to {{Fortune River}} * [[Beachgoer]] * [[Surfer]] * [[Resident]] * [[Trader]] - see '''Summer Collection''' below == Unique Features == === Summer Collection === [[File:Summer Collection.png|thumb|Empty crates, waiting to be filled]] Submit 10 ores with the Summer, Tidal, or Hearthflame [[Modifiers|modifiers]] to the crates next to the [[Trader]]. Wait 1 hour for them to be delivered, and then claim rewards including [[Relics|relics]] and {{Sand Dollars|Sand Dollars}}. The quality of the delivery depends on the ore rarities and modifiers. The weight of the ores doesn't matter. {| class="wikitable" |- ! Delivery Quality ! Summer ! Tidal ! Hearthflame |- ! {{Common}} | 2% || 4% || 5% |- ! {{Uncommon}} | 3% || 6% || 7.5% |- ! {{Rare}} | 5% || 10% || 12.5% |- ! {{Epic}} | 8% || 16% || 20% |- ! {{Legendary}} | 12% || 24% || 30% |- ! {{Mythic}} | 25% || 50% || 62.5% |- ! {{Exotic}} | 50% || 100% || 125% |} === Bonfire === [[File:Bonfire - in progress.png|200px|border|Sand Dollar collection in progress]] [[File:Bonfire - active.png|200px|border|Goal reached!]]
Whenever the global Sand Dollar collection goal is reached, the bonfire in the center of Seashell Isle lights up, starting a random [[Events|event]]. All methods of Sand Dollar acquisition count towards the goal - finding them on beaches and deposits, getting them from the Summer Collection, and completing quests. The Bonfire randomly selects one of these events: * [[Events#tabber-Night_of_the_Bonfire_-_Limited|Night of the Bonfire]] * [[Events#tabber-Meteor_Shower|Meteor Shower]] * [[Events#tabber-4×_Luck|4× Luck]] * [[Events#tabber-8×_Luck|8× Luck]] ==== Extending the Bonfire ==== If players collect sufficient {{Sand Dollars|Sand Dollars}} '''while the Bonfire is lit''', the event currently running (Meteor Shower, Night of the Bonfire, 4× Luck, ''or'' 8× Luck) is extended by 15 minutes. The goal to be reached is shown above the Bonfire while it is lit. === ''Shifting Tides'' Hourly Event === [[File:Shifting tides at Windswept beach.png|300px|right]] The '''Shifting Tides''' event happens every hour at XX:05 and lasts '''15 minutes'''. It gives a +1× {{Stat|Luck}} Boost to all locations, and gives a chance of the [[Modifiers#Tidal|Tidal modifier]] on ores collected at beach deposits. * Beach deposits will have large swirling circles, but it is not necessary to dig/pan in those circles - the Tidal modifier chance applies to the whole deposit. == Digsite == '''Seashell Beach''' is the only digsite in this event location. The toughness requirement is 1, so any [[Shovels|shovel]] will work. {{Tocright}}

'''John''' is an [[NPCs|NPC]] located at {{Rubble Creek}}.  
He is the '''first NPC''' players encounter in ''Prospecting!'' and serves as the tutorial guide.  

John introduces players to the basics of panning, selling, and upgrading tools before giving his main set of quests.

== Tutorial ==
John guides the player through the basics of the game.  

=== Objectives ===
* Pan at the river bank  
* Sift the pan in the water

pages.Island Guide:
[[File:Island Guide.png|thumb|The Island Guide is ready to tell you all about Seashell Isle]]
The '''Island Guide''' is an [[NPCs|NPC]] located at [[Seashell Isle]].  

== Dialogue ==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:Welcome to Seashell Isle! I'm your guide here, got any questions?  

:{{Choice|1. What can I do here?}}  
::We've got a bunch of vendors selling their goods for Sand Dollars!  
::Make sure to buy their items before the event ends!  

:{{Choice|2. How do I earn Sand Dollars?}}  
::The trader near the crates over there is your best bet.
::Heard they've found a client who is willing to trade Sand Dollars for Summer and Tidal ores.
::Though, I'm sure some of the patrons here might be willing to give some.
::You can also find Sand Dollars lying around beaches and deposits!
::That's where they come from, after all!

:{{Choice|3. Where is this place?}}
::Seashell Isle is a moving island that floats around on its own!
::Why, you ask?
::I have no idea!
::What we do know is that it only floats close enough to the mainland to sail here in the summer.
::It's a pretty cool place, so we hold festivals here while we can!

{{Dialogue End}}

pages.Shopkeepers:
[[File:Shopkeeper.png|right|300px]]

The '''Shopkeeper''' is a recurring [[NPCs|NPC]] in ''Prospecting!''.  
They appear in several towns and digsites, usually close to [[Shovels]] and [[Pans]] vendors.  

Unlike the [[Merchant]], Shopkeepers don’t sell items directly. Instead, they act as the NPC tied to tool purchases, giving players access to new digging equipment.  

== Gameplay ==
Shopkeepers allow the player to:
* Buy [[Shovels]] and [[Pans]] in their vicinity
* Access stronger digging tools as progression unlocks
* Serve as an alternate shop NPC (similar to [[Shard Merchant]] and [[Traveling Merchant]])  

== Locations ==

=== Mainland ===
* {{Rubble Creek}} — near [[John]]  
* {{Fortune River Town}} — opposite the [[Shard Merchant]] inside the shop building  
* {{Crystal Caverns}} — near the [[Merchant]] by the {{Crystal Cavern River}}  

== Notes ==
* Shopkeepers do not sell items other than [[Shovels]] and [[Pans]].  
* They serve as the main vendors for upgrading digging tools.

The '''Resident''' is an [[NPCs|NPC]] located in {{Fortune River Town}}.  
She is excited to explain the recent prospector influx to the player.  

She also shows up, having exchanged her plaid flannel shirt for a Hawaiian one, at {{Seashell Isle}} during the Summer Event.

== Dialogue ==

=== Fortune River ===
:'''Resident''': Fortune River flows down from the Meteor Peaks.  
:'''Resident''': The meteors that land up there break into pieces and flow down the river.  
:'''Resident''': That's why there's so much gold here!  

=== Seashell Isle ===
:'''Resident''': It's always good to take a break once in a while.
:'''Resident''': Life is short, so you should enjoy it!

pages.Scientist:
[[File:Scientist.png|thumb|''the '''Scientist''' inspecting an Azuralite Crystal'']]
{{Tocright}}

The '''Scientist''' is an [[NPCs|NPC]] located by the {{Crystal Cavern River}} in the {{Crystal Caverns}}.  

They are conducting research on the strange properties of [[Azuralite]], which appears to grow naturally within the caves.  

== Dialogue ==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Scientist:''' Hmm… one millimeter of growth today?  
:'''Scientist:''' It seems to be slowing down…  

:{{Choice|What are you looking at?}}  
::'''Scientist:''' Azuralite crystals. They seem to grow on their own.  
::'''Scientist:''' This cave used to be rather empty and boring, but the appearance of these crystals has attracted a lot of attention.  
::'''Scientist:''' We aren’t sure why they grow, either. What a mystery!  

:{{Choice|Does it matter if they stop growing?}}  
::'''Scientist:''' Perhaps. If they stop entirely, it could mean the cavern’s energy is fading.  
::'''Scientist:''' Or maybe it’s just natural… hard to say without more research.  
{{Dialogue End}}

[[File:Nuclear Scientist Device.png|thumb|The Nuclear Scientist with his reactor/device/thingie]] {{Tocright}} The '''Nuclear Scientist''' is a [[:Category:Quests|quest-giving]] [[NPCs|NPC]] found in {{Rotwood Swamp}}. He's somewhat, um, ''relaxed'' about minor little things like exploding reactors, and he's happy to ask his [[Mad Scientist|colleague in the Crystal Caves]] for help. == Location == [[File:Nuclear Scientist location.png|none|300px]] The Nuclear Scientist is located towards the edge of Rotwood Swamp, kind of between [[Swamp Man]] and the main town. The device he's building is just visible from the Rotwood Swamp [[Waypoints#tabber-Rotwood_Swamp|Waypoint]]. == Quest == {{Quest |Quest = Going Nuclear [1] |QuestSub = Help the Nuclear Scientist build his reactor. |QuestStep1 = Collect 200 [[Bismuth]]. |QuestStep2 = Collect 1000 [[Cobalt]]. |QuestStep3 = Collect 2500 [[Electrum]]. |Rewards = {{$|10,000,000,000}} • {{EXP|1,000,000}} • 2,500 {{Meteor Shard}} }} {{Quest |Quest = Going Nuclear [2] |QuestSub = Help the Nuclear Scientist build his reactor. |QuestStep1 = Talk to the Nuclear Scientist. |Rewards = {{$|10,000,000,000}} • {{EXP|1,000,000}} • 2,500 {{Meteor Shard}} }} {{Quest |Quest = Going Nuclear [3] |QuestSub = Help the Nuclear Scientist build his reactor. |QuestStep1 = Talk to the [[Mad Scientist]]. |Rewards = {{$|10,000,000,000}} • {{EXP|1,000,000}} • 2,500 {{Meteor Shard}} }} {{Quest |Quest = Going Nuclear [6] |QuestSub = Help the Nuclear Scientist build his reactor. |QuestStep1 = Talk to the Nuclear Scientist. |Rewards = {{$|10,000,000,000}} • {{EXP|1,000,000}} • 2,500 {{Meteor Shard}} }} {{Quest |Quest = Going Nuclear [7] |QuestSub = Help the Nuclear Scientist build his reactor. |QuestStep1 = Collect 5 [[Vineheart]]. |QuestStep2 = Collect 3 [[Umbrite]]. |QuestStep3 = Collect 1 [[Eternium]]. |Rewards = {{$|10,000,000,000}} • {{EXP|1,000,000}} • 2,500 {{Meteor Shard}} }} {{Quest |Quest = Going Nuclear [8] |QuestSub = Help the Nuclear Scientist build his reactor. |QuestStep1 = Talk to the Nuclear Scientist. |Rewards = {{$|10,000,000,000}} • {{EXP|1,000,000}} • 2,500 {{Meteor Shard}} }} ;Unlisted Reward: [[Trinkets|Mass Reactor trinket]] == Dialogue == {{Dialogue Start}} :Greetings, prospector! Mind giving me a hand? :I'm building a prototype reactor core to solve the rising costs of electricity! :I'm almost done, I just need a few materials to finish it up. {{Choice|Sure!}} :Great! Just find these, it shouldn't take you too long! :;Quest step started: '''Going Nuclear [1]''' {{Choice|Why build it here?}} :Because this swamp is already a toxic wasteland! :Nobody would care if it explodes here.
::{{Choice|It explodes?}}
::Well... Hopefully not. Can't be too sure, though. {{Choice|No}} : ... ---- {{Action|While quest step 1 is in progress}} :Have you found the materials yet? {{Action|Quest step 1 complete}} :... :You've got the materials? Great! :Time to finish the core up! Just a few screws here... :...A weld here... :... :Uh... It's not working. Err... :Plan B! One of my colleagues should be nearby, he's a pretty smart guy. :Can you show the Prototype to him and see what he thinks? :I heard he set up a lab in the Caverns. :;Quest step started: '''Going Nuclear [3]''' {{Action|Before talking to Mad Scientist}} :Show the Prototype to my colleague, he should be in a lab in the Caverns. ---- {{Action|Coming back from [[Mad Scientist]] - Quest step 6}} :You're back! Did he fix it? :... :Well, it turns on at least! I can work with this. :I just need a few more special materials. :Find them for me and we can finish this! :;Quest step started: '''Going Nuclear [7]''' {{Action|Before finishing step 7}} :Have you found the materials yet? {{Action|Quest finished}} ::'''System message''': ''Unlocked trinket: Mass Reactor'' ::'''System message''': ''Quest 'Going Nuclear' completed!'' :Great work! Now let me just insert it... :*rumble* :It works! It doesn't produce any energy though... :Where's the fuel going? :Y'know, I don't think this is going to work. :Here, you can take it. Maybe you can figure it out. ---- {{Action|After quest is complete}} :Hmm. What should I do now? {{Dialogue End}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Rotwood Swamp]]
pages.River Researcher:
[[File:River_Researcher.png|300px|thumb|The River Researcher gazing out over the water]] The '''River Researcher''' is a [[Quests|quest-giving]] [[NPCs|NPC]] standing on the dock at the {{Sandstone Stream}}. == Quest == {{Quest | Quest = River Monitoring |QuestSub = Ensure that there are no irregularities in the river's flow. |QuestStep1 = Collect 10,000 {{Legendary}} Materials from {{Sunscorched Desert}}. |QuestStep2 = Collect 1,000 {{Mythic}} Materials from Sunscorched Desert. |QuestStep3 = Collect 25 {{Exotic}} Materials from Sunscorched Desert. |Rewards = {{$|25,000,000,000}} • {{EXP|2,000,000}} • {{Meteor Shards|1,000}} }} == Dialogue == {{Dialogue Start}} :You don't look too busy! Mind giving me a hand? {{Choice|Sure! What is it?}} ::This river is the lifeline both the towns and the environment. ::I'm here to ensure nothing is wrong with it, since it would be devastating if it dried up! ::It's a bunch of work though, which is why I need some help.
{{Choice|What should I do?}}
::Collect some minerals from the river so I can test them ::;(Quest 'River Monitoring' started!) ::I'll need quite a bit, so it might take a while. ::Good luck! {{Choice|2. Nah!}} ::Ok. ----- {{Action|While quest is in progress}} :I'll need more samples than that. ----- {{Action|Quest completion}} :Looks like you collected enough samples! :;(Quest 'River Monitoring' completed!) :We'll need more specialized equipment to do a detailed analysis, but... :At a glance, nothing looks wrong, so the river should be stable for now. :Thanks for the help! Here's some of my funding. ----- {{Action|After completion}} :Thanks for the help! The river is looking stable for now. {{Dialogue End}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:Quests]]

pages.Volcanic Researcher: [[File:Volcanic_researcher.png|thumb|The '''Volcanic Researcher''' standing by one of the springs.]] {{Tocright}} The '''Volcanic Researcher''' is a [[:Category:Quests|quest-giving]] [[NPCs|NPC]] located at the [[Volcanic Springs]] on [[Caldera Island]]. They are a cheerful academic dedicated to studying the mineral content of the local springs. == Quests == {{Quest |Quest = Volcanic Springs [1] |QuestStep1 = Collect 100 [[Zircon|Zircon]] |QuestStep2 = Collect 10 [[Osmium|Osmium]] |QuestStep3 = Collect 1 [[Radium|Radium]] |Rewards = {{$|4,000,000}} • {{EXP|80,000}} • 400 {{Meteor Shard}} }} == Dialogue == {{Dialogue Start}} :'''Volcanic Researcher:''' Hi I'm studying the mineral content of these volcanic springs! :{{Choice|No.}} :'''Volcanic Researcher:''' Ok! Have a nice day! :{{Choice|Sure.}} :'''Volcanic Researcher:''' Alright, just collect these minerals! ::;(Quest started: '''Volcanic Sands''') {{Dialogue End}} ---- ;(While quest is active, not completed) :'''Volcanic Researcher:''' Everything going well? pages.Veteran Ranger: [[File:Veteran_ranger.png|thumb|280px|''Veteran Ranger'' looking in the distance]] {{Tocright}} The '''Veteran Ranger''' is a [[:Category:Quests|quest-giving]] [[NPCs|NPC]] located on the cliffside near the Lighthouse at [[Windswept Beach]]. A dedicated lookout who spends his time scanning the horizon for lost ships, he’s a bit hampered by his lack of a proper map. == Quests == {{Quest |Quest = S.O.S [1] |QuestStep1 = Bring a map of Windswept Beach to the Veteran Ranger |Rewards = Title: Ranger • {{EXP|750,000}} • 1,500 {{Meteor Shard}} }} == Dialogue == {{Dialogue Start}} :'''Veteran Ranger:''' A prospector huh? Come to enjoy the view? :{{Choice|Yeah}} :'''Veteran Ranger:''' I see... don't mind me then. :{{Choice|What are you doing?}} :'''Veteran Ranger:''' Some ships have been getting lost around here. Trying to keep a look out for one, but it's hard without a map. :{{Choice|Oh, well that's too bad}} :'''Veteran Ranger:''' I suppose so, anyway I gotta keep an eye out. :{{Choice|Any way I can help?}} :'''Veteran Ranger:''' I wouldn't mind a map of the nearby area. If you can find one I'll make it worth your effort ::;(Quest started: '''S.O.S''') {{Dialogue End}} ---- ;(While quest is active, not completed) :'''Veteran Ranger:''' You find a map yet? If so hold it out and show me! ---- ;(Quest completion) :'''Veteran Ranger:''' Is that a treasure map? That... That works! How generous and creative of you, a fine aspect most young Rangers aspire to have. Consider yourself an Honorary Ranger! Oh and take this reward! ::;Rewards given: Title: Ranger • {{EXP|750,000}} • 1,500 {{Meteor Shard}} ---- ;(After completion) :'''Veteran Ranger:''' Thanks for your assistance! With this I can keep an eye out! [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Windswept Beach]]
pages.Valley Girl: [[File:valleygirl.png|thumb]] {{Tocright}} The '''Valley Girl''' is a [[:Category:Quests|quest-giving]] [[NPCs|NPC]] located in the [[Meteor Valley]]. Easily distracted by anything pink and sparkly, she is absolutely obsessed with the valley's aesthetic. = Quests = {{Quest |Quest = Help the Valley Girl [1] |QuestStep1 = Bring 1 Vortessence to the Valley Girl in Meteor Valley: 0/1 |QuestStep2 = Bring 1 Star Garnet to the Valley Girl in Meteor Valley: 0/1 |QuestStep3 = Bring 1 Sunstone to the Valley Girl in Meteor Valley: 0/1 |Rewards = {{$|500,000,000,000}} • {{EXP|1,000,000}} • 400 {{Meteor Shard}}}} == Dialogue == {{Dialogue Start}} :'''Valley Girl:''' I am in love with this place! It's so pink and sparkly! Just hold it out and show it to me. ---- ;(Quest completion) :'''Valley Girl:''' Yay, thank you! :'''Valley Girl:''' *gasps* Wow they are even shinier than I thought! Here, take this. Thanks!!! ::;Rewards given: {{$|500,000,000,000}} • {{EXP|1,000,000}} • 400 {{Meteor Shard}} ---- ;(After completion) :'''Valley Girl:''' I am in love with this place! pages.Valley Golem: [[File:golemvalley.PNG|thumb]] {{Tocright}} The '''Valley Golem''' is a [[:Category:Quests|quest-giving]] [[NPCs|NPC]] located in the [[Meteor Valley]]. A gentle but loud giant who simply wants to collect "shinies." Because he has grown too large to move effectively, he relies on "tiny person things" to bring him a hoard of colorful gems, rewarding them with the meteor shards that naturally sprout from his stony skin. == Quests == {{Quest |Quest = Help The Valley Golem [1] |QuestStep1 = Collect 3000 Gold: 0/2000 |QuestStep2 = Collect 2000 Sapphire: 0/2000 |QuestStep3 = Collect 100 Jade: 0/200 |QuestStep4 = Collect 100 Aquamarine: 0/200 |QuestStep5 = Collect 10 Star Garnet: 0/10 |Rewards = {{$|0}} • {{EXP|5,000,000}} • 3,000 {{Meteor Shard}} }} == Dialogue == {{Dialogue Start}} :'''Valley Golem:''' *stoney grumbling* Welcome to meteor valley tiny person thing. Me need help, could you help? :{{Choice|What's wrong?}} ::'''Valley Golem:''' Me like shiny rocks ::'''Valley Golem:''' Me want to get shiny rocks on me own but me grow so big, it hard to move around and get shinies :( :{{Choice|...}} ::'''Valley Golem:''' *stoney grumbling* :{{Choice|Don't worry big rock thing.}} ::'''Valley Golem:''' SHINIIIIIIIIIIEEEEEEEEESSSSSSS!!!!!! *loud stoney sounds* THANKS TINY PERSON THING! ::;(Quest started: '''The Golem's Shinies''') :{{Choice|I'm sorry but I can't help you}} ::'''Valley Golem:''' *stoney grumbling* {{Dialogue End}} ---- ;(While quest is active, not completed) :'''Valley Golem:''' *stoney grumbling* ---- ;(Quest completion) :'''Valley Golem:''' SHINIIIIIIIIIIEEEEEEEEESSSSSSS!!!!!! *loud stoney sounds* THANKS TINY PERSON THING! :'''Valley Golem:''' Here, take these meteor shards, they keep growing on me body ::;Rewards given: 1,000 {{Meteor Shard}} ---- ;(After completion) :'''Valley Golem:''' *stoney grumbling* [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:Quests]]

This template standardizes mineral pages. == Usage == Basic: 
{{Mineral
| name        = Pyrite
| image       = Pyritehd.png
| description = Also known as "Fool's Gold".
| rarity      = Common
| value       = 500
| locations   = * [[Rubble Creek Sands]]
| chances     = * '''[[Rubble Creek Sands]]''' – 13.17% (~1 in 8)
| recipes     = === [[Garden Glove]] ({{Common}}) ===
* 5× '''Pyrite'''
* 1× [[Titanium]]
* 5× [[Gold]]
| trivia      = * Sparks when struck against steel (from Greek ''pyr'').
}}
Parameters: * name – display name (required) * image – file name (optional) * description – short one-liner (optional) * rarity – Common / Uncommon / Rare / Legendary (used for auto-categories) * value – price per kg (number only) * locations – short list for infobox (bullets recommended) * chances – expanded location/chance list (bullets) * recipes – full wikitext for recipes * trivia – bullet list of facts (optional) __NOTOC__{{Mineral Infobox | name = {{{name|}}} | image = {{{image|}}} | description = {{{description|}}} | rarity = {{{rarity|}}} | value = {{{value|}}} | locations = {{{locations|}}} }} == Locations & Chances == {{#if:{{{chances|}}}| {{{chances}}} | {{#if:{{{locations|}}}|{{{locations}}}|''No known spawn locations.''}} }} == Uses & Recipes == {{#if:{{{recipes|}}}|{{{recipes}}}|''No known uses.''}} {{#if:{{{trivia|}}}| == Trivia == {{{trivia}}} | }} [[Category:Minerals]]
